raised: The fund code appears as '(4D)' in one place and '(D4)' in another, so it is unclear whether they are the same fund
Psagot is one of the firms whose advertised fees don't match their documents ('3 טענות')
The default pick, Interactive Israel, is labelled 'לא בפיקוח רשות ני"ע', which scared the reader off
The exchange-rate strip mentions the European central bank, which seems irrelevant and confusing
Unclear what the inflation button does and whether the 7% is before or after inflation
'אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל' worried the reader: what happens if the dollar does move?
Didn't understand why the tax differs between firms for the same index
The long fund list is confusing: many coloured labels, plus 'אין מחיר כאן' and 'עוד לא נאסף'
Psagot shows 'אין נתון' for the standing-order price even though it is supposed to be the cheapest
The explanation of why some funds have no price at Interactive Israel, and of 'מול המדד', was only half understood
The currency-hedging section is too much to take in
The waterfall chart is one grey column in a big empty space and says nothing
'נשען על כלל מס פתוח: מוצג ולא מדורג' lost the reader
The grey 'העמלות זו על זו' segment is not understood
The small coloured strips and small numbers in the account list are unclear
Jargon not understood: 4D/4A, דמי משמרת, מחלקת דיבידנד, צובר, W-8BEN, קרן מחקה vs קרן סל
Couldn't find the management fee of the recommended Yelin Lapidot fund
Unclear whether the final amounts include the tax paid when selling at the end
No information on what happens if the money is needed after 5 years
No information on what happens if the brokerage firm collapses
No way to open the account: no phone number or link for Psagot
Would drop the bottom tables ('חשבון אחר, אותה קרן' and the rest)
Would drop the line chart in 'מה הכי משנה'

problems.why: The report never mentions the '(מותג של MEXEM LTD)' parenthesis or any clutter in the chosen account's name.
